package types

Ptr :: ^int
Multi :: [^]u8
Slice :: []int
Fixed :: [4]int
Inferred := [?]int{1, 2}
Dyn :: [dynamic]int
Capped :: [dynamic; 8]int
Table :: map[string]int
Flags :: bit_set[Color; u8]
Range_Set :: bit_set[0 ..< 8]
Mat :: matrix[2, 3]f32
Vec :: #simd[4]f32
Soa_Slice :: #soa[]Point
Soa_Fixed :: #soa[4]Point
Color :: enum u8 { Red, Green = 2, Blue }
By_Color :: [Color]int
Sparse :: #sparse[Color]int
Packed :: struct #packed { a: u8, b: u32 }
Raw :: struct #raw_union { i: i32, f: f32 }
Aligned :: struct #align(16) { x: int "tag" }
Generic :: struct($T: typeid, $N: int) where N > 0 { items: [N]T }
Point :: struct {
    using base: Base,
    x, y: f32,
}
Base :: struct {}
Value :: union #no_nil { int, f64 }
Shared :: union #shared_nil #align(8) { ^int, rawptr }
Maybe_Gen :: union($T: typeid) { T }
Id :: distinct int
Bits :: bit_field u16 {
    low:  u8 | 4,
    high: u8 | 4 "tag",
}
Any_Value :: any
Type_Id :: typeid
